Note:

[Story]
At a family gathering, there are 16 people indoors and outdoors, almost a quarter of them are children. Xiao Ming looks around indoors and finds that 2 of them are children.

[Question]
Before Xiao Ming looks around indoors, how many children does he guess?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Before Xiao Ming looks around indoors, he guesses 5 children.
B. Before Xiao Ming looks around indoors, he guesses 3 children.
C. Before Xiao Ming looks around indoors, he guesses 4 children.
D. After Xiao Ming looks around indoors, he guesses 2 children.
